items.name: utils
items.title: cn()
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge configured for the ws-* token scales. Every Wideset component imports it.

items.name: logic
items.title: Date helpers
items.description: Date formatting and range helpers shared by the date pickers.

items.name: icon-types
items.title: Icon types
items.description: Type for the Remix Icon components Wideset accepts as props.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: MotionProvider, the motion recipes and useShake: how components animate, and the switch that turns motion off.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme
items.description: Toggles the dark class on the document root.

items.name: styles
items.title: Wideset styles
items.description: Compiled tokens, component CSS and the Tailwind utilities components use. No reset, no font. Every component depends on it.
items.docs: Import it once in your app. Vite: `import '@/styles/wideset.css'` in main.tsx. Tailwind entry file: `@import './wideset.css';` next to your other imports.

items.name: skills
items.title: Wideset agent skills
items.description: Agent Skills for building with Wideset, for Codex, Cursor and other agents that read .agents/skills, plus AGENTS.wideset.md and a Cursor rule.
items.docs: Point your agent at the rules: add `See AGENTS.wideset.md for Wideset rules.` to AGENTS.md. `npx wideset skills` does this for you.

items.name: skills-claude
items.title: Wideset agent skills for Claude Code
items.description: The same Agent Skills in .claude/skills, where Claude Code reads them, plus the two reviewer agents.
items.docs: Import the rules from CLAUDE.md: add `@AGENTS.wideset.md`. `npx wideset skills` does this for you.

items.name: preflight
items.title: Wideset preflight
items.description: Tailwind's browser reset, for apps without Tailwind. Apps with Tailwind v4 already have it.
items.docs: Import it before wideset.css. Vite: `import '@/styles/wideset-preflight.css'` in main.tsx.

items.name: theme
items.title: Wideset theme
items.description: Uncompiled @theme and @utility source for apps running Tailwind v4, so their own build compiles the ws-* classes. Add it next to styles: it has no element rules (font smoothing, 1em icon sizing) and no plugins; radix-* and animate-* classes need tailwindcss-radix and tailwindcss-animate.
items.docs: In your Tailwind entry file, after `@import 'tailwindcss';` add `@import './wideset-theme.css';` and `@plugin 'tailwindcss-radix'; @plugin 'tailwindcss-animate';`.

items.name: accordion

items.name: action-tile

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar

items.title: Breadcrumbs

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button triggers an action. Composes with Button.Icon and Button.TruncatedText.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar lets the user pick a single date or a date range.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card is a flexible surface for grouping related content, media, and actions into one container.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip

items.title: ComboBox

items.name: field-label
items.title: FieldLabel

items.name: file-item

items.name: file-upload
items.title: FileUpload

items.name: filter-button
items.title: FilterButton

items.name: form-field
items.title: FormField

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton

items.name: inline-alert
items.title: InlineAlert

items.name: link-button
items.title: LinkButton

items.name: list-item
items.title: ListItem

items.name: modal

items.name: multi-select

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination

items.name: popup
items.title: Popup

items.name: select

items.name: sidepanel

items.name: slider

items.name: status-modal

items.title: SystemAlert
